title: Game jam
description: A time-boxed community design event. Jams are the platform's front door: the event is the reason to show up, entries are the content, and constraints are DATA — machine-checkable with `fmt jam-check`, so 'does my entry qualify' is a command, not a mod ruling. Files: jams/*.yaml at repo root.

theme.description: The creative prompt. Revealed at start for blind jams.

constraints.description: Machine-checkable entry rules. Anything here is enforced by fmt jam-check.

max_deck_size.description: Max physical cards (sum of printing quantities).

required_license.description: Entry must use one of these licenses (jams are usually open — that's the point).

theme_word_required.description: Theme word must appear in title, a card name, or rules text.

notes.description: Human rules that aren't machine-checkable (judged by hosts).

game_id.description: Slug of a game hosted here (links the jam page to the game page).

url.description: External entry (repo/itch page) — jams welcome outsiders.
